items.rationale: Section 5.2.6(b) covers the assessment as a separate cost from leak location. One flat rate at €524 is below the €3,000 assessment limit.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers leak location. Using the comparable bundled charge in case 20 and allowing separately for technician time and travel, the detection itself is estimated at €500; detection plus technician time stays below the €1,000 limit.

Section 5.2.6(a) expressly covers on-site technician time, and the detection line does not state that it includes that labour. The invoiced 2.5 hours × €60 gives €150 within the shared €1,000 leak-location limit.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge for this contractor on this invoice. The single €79 charge is below the €83.30 gross cap.

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 treats ageing-related leakage as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking, and section 9.1.1 does not treat age alone as a breach. The single flat rate for sealing or locally renewing the two verified joints is estimated at €400.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking pipe run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.5 exclude replacement of sections not shown to be leaking. The conditional estimate is €3,500 for the single whole-run flat rate.
Section 7.1.9 limits reinstatement to the pre-loss specification, so the separately billed premium upgrade is excluded. The conditional estimate for the single surcharge is €600.

Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge on the plumber's separate invoice because the visit included an insured repair. The €79 charge is below the €83.30 gross cap; the €500 deductible applies once to the event, not separately to each line.
